businessModelStatement: BrokenToFixed is a handyman matching service run by the OurKampung team. We pass your enquiry to a partner handyman, who quotes and does the job.

formSubmit.note: The build variable PUBLIC_FORM_ENDPOINT overrides defaultEndpoint. Both are FormSubmit's alias for the family inbox, which the user confirmed on 5 Oct 2026 reaches it; the raw address is no longer used. The form posts to the /ajax/ form of whichever is used. FormSubmit may ask for a fresh activation the first time a new site posts to it, so send one test enquiry from the live domain (with the user's OK) and click the confirmation link.
